title: Tuna

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Tuna are passive creatures (fish) found in the Ocean biome.
They can be caught with a fishing pole using Heavy fishing bait which can be crafted at a Food preparation table using Fishing bait and a Serpent trophy.
Needed to craft a Fishing hat

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Has a unique line: "I've got this tune stuck in my head..."
